author: Simmons Bamber
title: Broken and unfair chat moderation
content:
The chat moderation and reporting system has single-handedly ruined my experience with this game. I’ve been a longtime player, I genuinely enjoy the game, and I’ve spent a good amount of money on skins over the years, but I’m getting tired of being punished by a system that feels completely unfair.

Another player can instigate an argument or say something to you, you simply respond without saying anything abusive or inappropriate, and if they decide to report you, somehow you’re the one who ends up chat banned while they receive absolutely nothing. Then you’re unable to properly communicate with your teammates and friends for the next 2-6 matches because of what is a false report.

The appeal system makes it even more frustrating. Appeals never get approved, and it feels like the actual context of the conversation is never reviewed. Reports should be evaluated based on what was actually said and the full conversation, not simply because someone decided to hit the report button after an argument they initiated.

I’ve spoken with other players who are frustrated with the same issue. I enjoy Mobile Legends and wouldn’t have supported the game for this long if I didn’t, but this moderation system has genuinely ruined a huge part of the experience for me. Players shouldn’t have to worry that simply responding to someone who instigates an argument will leave them unable to communicate with their team for multiple matches. The reporting and appeal system desperately needs to be fixed.

author: wakamoli3
title: Absolutely Terrible Matchmaking System
content:
Are we serious ? What are all these teammates, is this all the bot you use just to fill in the game slot ?
I have been playing Mobile Legends for nine years. Nine. I have watched this game grow from the start till now, I have stuck through every rework, every meta shift, and through all of it, the matchmaking has remained a joke.

The game lately feel less like ranked matches and more like a test to see how many bots you can cram into one lobby and still call it competitive. Teammates who don't rotate, don't ping, don't react to anything happening on the map, are these people even real players, or are you just padding queue times with AI fillers and hoping nobody notices?

If this is deliberate some kind of engagement trick, retention algorithm, whatever you want to call it be honest about it. If it's not, then it's just incompetence at this point, because nine years is long enough to expect a matchmaking system that actually matches skill level instead of throwing five random cards in the air and calling it a team.

I'm not asking for perfection. I'm asking for a game that respects the time of players who've stuck around this long. Fix your matchmaking, or start being upfront about what's actually happening in these lobbies.

author: whydoineedanucknametwo
title: Less and less support
content:
The game has been in a steady decline of dev support.  No reports for player misconduct is addressed beyond the automated system.   Functions like uploading or changing pictures doesn’t work, updating your location info doesn’t work.   And it seems to be getting worse.

Now the biggest issue is the dark match making system.  Where the game punishes you for playing well.  It literally forces you to play with extremely unskilled players.  It’s not about matching you with players similar MMR, it’s about creating teams with similar avg mmr.  Or at least that’s what it appears to be.  And maybe that’s because there’s not enough players (especially after they removed the ability to play with people globally). And it’s funny because all other games out there still work fine with cross country servers.   

The people behind the game name don’t care about the players.  They will do enough to keep game running while milking people for micro transaction income with lower quality skins that look AI generated and just a bunch of BS tossed together. 

That being said, the game can be fun, and 30-40% of the time the games can be balanced.  

Very respectfully a solo roam main who gets to immortal every season (at a cost to my mental health)

author: Jacob Yealminthein
title: Dark System
content:
This game’s matchmaking and so-called “Dark System” are incredibly frustrating and unfair. It feels like the system intentionally creates unbalanced teams, putting strong players together with players who have completely different skill levels.

Instead of creating fair and competitive matches, the matchmaking often feels predetermined. No matter how well you play, you can end up repeatedly carrying teammates who clearly don’t belong in the same rank or skill level.

Ranked matches should be based on fair matchmaking and player performance—not a system that makes players feel punished for winning too much or playing well.

Mobile Legends has the potential to be a great competitive game, but the current matchmaking system destroys the experience. Please seriously improve the team balancing and matchmaking algorithm. Players want fair matches, not forced losses and frustrating, unbalanced games.

author: Pharaoh@4686
title: Matchmaking and Penalties Need a Serious Rework
content:
This game seriously needs to fix its reporting, penalties, and matchmaking system because it’s getting ridiculous.

If a player is having a bad game, struggling with internet issues, not getting kills, or simply playing differently than their teammates, that does NOT automatically mean they’re throwing the game. If they’re still moving, fighting, defending, pushing, helping, and trying to finish the match, the game should be able to recognize that.

Just because 3 or 4 teammates want to play one specific way doesn’t mean everyone else has to follow their strategy. Everybody has their own playstyle. People shouldn’t be able to gang up and report somebody just because they didn’t play exactly how the group wanted them to.

And the internet issue is even worse. If the game can detect somebody is lagging or having connection problems, then use that information before handing out penalties. There’s a difference between someone intentionally going AFK and somebody fighting through a terrible connection trying to stay in the game.

The ranked matchmaking is another huge problem. Stop putting players with completely different skill levels together and expecting the match to be balanced. Experienced players getting matched with people who barely know what they’re doing makes ranked feel less like competition and more like a punishment.

Mobile Legends needs to stop looking at nothing but kills, deaths, reports, and whether someone followed the team’s strategy. Actually look at what the player was doing during the match.

People play differently. People have bad games. People lag. That doesn’t automatically make them a troll or a bad player.

Fix the matchmaking. Fix the reporting system. Fix the penalties. And start using some actual intelligence when deciding who deserves to be punished.
